canonical_project: Gwangju AI Industry Convergence Cluster National AI Data Center
owner: Gwangju Metropolitan City / Korea AI Convergence Industry Cluster project; operated by NHN (NHN Cloud) under a national AI data center service
notes: The Gwangju AI-specialized data center, core facility of the Gwangju AI industry convergence cluster in the Advanced 3 District (Cheomdan 3), Buk-gu Oryong-dong near GIST, broke ground 2021-11-22; NHN was selected as cloud infrastructure builder/operator (2021) with 88.5 PF HPC planned from end-2022. The cluster comprises three buildings totalling about 47,256 sqm; national AI data center services began recruiting users from April 2026. No public MW figure found.
